Senses.Explanation: A paired-capability unit — able to let loose, able to seize away — the twin handles of the master's working hand, claimed over raised fists and four-line verses across the records. The root sits in Zhaozhou Congshen's own road record — walking into a hermitage, asking 'is there, is there?', meeting the raised fist, calling the first water too shallow to moor a boat, and at the second raised fist granting it: able to loose, able to seize — and bowing; Yuanwu Keqin raises the case at small meeting and turns the twin askings back on the hearers — where is the too-shallow-water place, where the loose-and-seize place — ruling every gloss of foreknowledge and of the tongue in Zhaozhou's mouth the wrong view that cannot swallow the chestnut-burr or leap the diamond ring; Linye Tongqi takes Gaofeng's four lines — the sea-floor mud ox, the cliff-side stone tiger — one sentence able to loose and seize, checked out, the seeking done — then sets his own four beside them: clear sky the sun comes out, rain the ground wet, short month twenty-nine, long month thirty — one sentence in there just as able, and if you cannot check it out, all please go drink tea; and Eryin Mi, installing the seat at Huiding, names the two apparatus — Deshan's means for the banner raised in the red-dust heap, the old sages' working authority for the mast in the busy market — the mechanism clear, high and low, great and small, all fused; the means complete, able to loose and able to seize, free in the loosing, at ease in the seizing, one mote holding the jeweled king's shrine and one shrine turning the great wheel. Yinyuan Longqi, New Year's Day at Wanfu, grants the whole year's purport — borderless realm realms issuing the king's command, all the land's people blessing the sovereign — wherein there is the provisional and the real, shining and working, able to loose and able to seize: mastered one by one, one may enter the Huangbo chamber, each hand hanging down to hold up the banner and repay the sovereign's bounty; Lüyan He, raising the case in the room, cries that great and small Zhaozhou had his eyes swapped by the two hermits and the mountain monk cannot walk past without righting it — then suddenly raises his own fist: able to loose, able to seize — and if you take it that way, one staff breaks your donkey's back; Shanyi Ruchun rules Gaofeng's report an empty fist fooling children, and Pure Seat Shanyi, refusing to trail along with the crowd, offers his own verse — the featherless hawk beating skyward, the frog preening in the treetops, the one-legged stone girl calling in the clouds, hare-horn and turtle-hair for a ladder — one sentence in there just as able to loose and seize, checked out, thirty blows not too many, for under a heavy bounty there must be a brave man; and Xuzhou Xingsheng, working the case line by line with running quips — the raised fist already a surrendered flag, a Persian showing pearls — then plays both hermits himself: as the first he answers 'causeless, causeless', as the second 'never met you face to face', and when Zhaozhou says able-to-loose-able-to-seize and bows, he lands one hard fist on his back — almost worthy of the raised fist.
